why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Create an account on Nous Portal . You can sign in with email, Google, Microsoft, GitHub, Discord or a wallet. The free tier costs nothing and covers free models only.

Install Hermes Agent from Nous's official docs and sign in with your Portal account. Warning The official install is a command that downloads a script and runs it in your terminal. Copy it only from Nous's own docs or GitHub, never from a post or a direct message.
Join the official Discord through the invite on Nous's site, discord.gg/nousresearch.
If you have data-centre-class GPUs, read the Psyche docs on GitHub and ask a run administrator to authorise your wallet.
